tried this new coffee shop in the late afternoon and it wasn’t too busy. the staff were very accommodating and gave great recommendations for their drinks and pastries. i got the ichiban matcha (7/10), which had a gentle bold and grassy aftertaste, though it was a bit sweeter than i expected even with balanced sweetness. sea salt spanish latte (9/10) because it wasn’t overly sweet and had a well-balanced flavor. i also enjoyed their biscoff scroll (9/10) since it wasn’t too sweet. the café has a clean, cozy atmosphere with a nice vibe, making it a great spot to relax.

First time visiting and I really liked the place. The café is cozy, clean, and has a relaxing atmosphere. I ordered the iced sea salt Spanish latte. It wasn’t bad, but it leaned more on the sweet side than I expected, so I couldn’t really taste the coffee as much. Overall, it was still a pleasant visit, and I’m looking forward to trying their other coffee drinks next time.
